name: What causes bathroom leaks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom leaks are commonly caused by worn-out seals, corroded pipes, loose connections, cracked grout or caulk, and faulty plumbing fixtures like faucets or toilets. For instance, a deteriorated wax seal at the base of your toilet is a frequent culprit for floor leaks. Regular maintenance and inspecting fixtures for wear can help prevent many common leak issues before they escalate.
